steps: Boil the potato and beetroot until a knife slides in easily, then peel them.
Blend coriander, mint, green chilli, garlic, a pinch of cumin, salt and lemon juice into a thick chutney.
Slice the potato, beetroot, cucumber, tomato and onion into thin rounds.
Spread soft butter on the bread, then a layer of green chutney on top.
Lay potato slices on one slice and dust them with chaat masala and roasted cumin.
Add beetroot, cucumber, tomato and onion, with a little more masala between the layers.
Close with the second slice, chutney side down, and press gently.
Eat it fresh as it is, or toast it on a tawa or in a sandwich maker until golden.
note: I used chaat masala with roasted cumin in place of a separate sandwich masala, and made the chutney part of the dish so one sandwich is two slices of bread. Toasting is optional, as it is on the street.
